notes: Transcribed from the fork, not upstream: ui/warrior/dps/presets.ts exists on the fork branch feat/upgrades-tab at this pin.

ui/specs/warrior/dps/spec.ts:64 (ui/warrior/dps/sim.ts:63 at this file's pin) wires P2_FURY_EP_PRESET, so Fury is the default variant. P3_ARMS_EP_PRESET is in arms-p3.ep-weights.json, which the Upgrades tab uses when the page's Arms tree has the most talent points (ticket 803); ep-weights-by-phase.json and the CLI read only this file and p2
